checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Watermark reads exactly '@flightschool' and visible throughout
must.why: No watermark text is visible in any of the four sampled frames.

must.item: Handle fixed at bottom right with clear margin
must.why: Nothing appears in the bottom-right corner.

must.item: Small, white, translucent, readable, subtle shadow
must.why: No text is present to judge.

must.item: Original footage unchanged apart from watermark, no extra card or scene
must.why: The footage looks re-rendered and softer at 832x512. The pilot and framing look a bit different, and there is a subtitle in frame 3. The cockpit content is broadly the same, with no extra card.

must.item: Output lasts 7 seconds and preserves original audio
must.why: The clip is 7 s and has sound with peak 0 dB. I can't verify that the audio matches the original.

exact_text.read_as: no watermark text visible in any frame

faults.what: The requested watermark is absent from all sampled frames, so the one task asked for was not done.
The clip was redrawn at lower resolution (480p, 832x512), which softens the footage even though the user said not to change anything.
A subtitle 'Rook, you with me?' appears at 2.8 s. It may come from the original, but it could be an unwanted addition.

summary: The 7 s cockpit clip came back lower-res, and none of the sampled frames show the requested '@flightschool' watermark, so the task failed.
